title: Clean Noise and Hide Picture work on one stretch of a clip
goal: With a range held over a picked clip, the right-click offers Mute Section, Speed for Section and the rest, but not Clean Noise in Section for a sound or Hide Picture for Section for a recording, because the app can only clean a whole sound and only show or hide a whole picture. Make both possible for just the stretch inside the range.
notes: The table is SectionOperation in Sources/PhotonzCore/RangeSection.swift; both rows exist with isAvailable == false, so turning them on is: a document edit in RangeSection.swift (tested), the row's action in Sources/Photonz/EditorState+RangeSection.swift sectionRow/canDo, and isAvailable true. Clean Noise today is AudioLevel.noiseReduction for the whole layer (NoiseCleaning.swift); a section version could split the clip at the range edges into its own layer, or carry per-stretch reduction. Hide Picture has no per-stretch model at all.
acceptance: Clean Noise in Section is offered for a sound picked under a range and cleans the sound inside the range only, as one step to undo
Hide Picture for Section is offered for a recording picked under a range and blanks its picture inside the range only, keeping its sound, as one step to undo
Both appear in Sequence > Picked in Range, lit when they apply
A walk proves each one inside and outside the range

log.note: Before building: a first-time user draws a range, clicks the recording, right-clicks: Hide Picture for Section must leave a visible mark on the bar or they cannot tell which stretch is off or why the picture vanished; Premiere's answer is a disabled clip drawn dim after a cut, so the stretch is cut at the range edges (as Speed and Freeze for Section already are), its filmstrip is left out and it carries a 'hidden' badge, and the piece's right-click offers Show Picture to take it back. Clean Noise in Section mirrors Premiere's effect on a cut segment: the clip is cut at the edges, that piece plays a cleaned copy of the file, its waveform is the cleaned one and it wears the sparkle badge; Remove Noise Cleaning on the sound clears it with the whole-sound cleaning. Model: two optional marks on a clip piece (picture off, noise strength), so a split never makes a second clip. Risk found: the fast export that copies a plain recording straight through must refuse a clip with either mark, or the export would skip them.

left rough, not filed: a section is cleaned at Medium with no strength choice, and the cleaning switches on hard at the cut with no crossfade; both are refinements the audit asks the user about rather than defects. Built: ClipPiece carries pictureHidden and noiseReduction (encoded only when set); Layer.isOnScreen reads a hidden piece as off screen (drawing, canvas clicks, handles); the mix plays Layer.sectionCleanedSounds for a cleaned piece (one copy per strength, learned from every cleaned stretch); CutCopy's fast export refuses a marked clip; Show Picture on the piece's right click and in Clip; Remove Noise Cleaning clears section cleaning too. Walk claims added: expectDrawn 'shown', expectLevel 'cleanedAt'/'rawAt'.

Clean Noise in Section and Hide Picture for Section now act on the stretch inside a range only, from the right click and Sequence > Picked in Range, each one undo step (commit ca23ab09). Hidden stretch: not drawn or clickable, sound plays on, dimmed with a 'hidden' badge, Show Picture brings it back. Cleaned stretch plays a cleaned copy. Verified: core tests (new SectionCleanAndHideTests), full suite 13170 green, hide-picture-and-clean-noise-for-a-section-walk and picked-in-range-menu-bar-walk green at Next defaults with real window captures; audit 2026-10-15-clean-noise-and-hide-picture-in-a-section.
